arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Katyal stated the claim targets fabricated evidence.
Mr. Katyal noted malicious prosecution is the closest analogy.
Mr. Wall argued favorable termination is an element.
Mr. O'Connor distinguished pure from impure malicious prosecution.
